name: Buttondown Free Newsletter
free_limit: Hosted newsletter sending for the first 100 active subscribers at $0, including rich-text/Markdown editor, custom sending domain and hosted newsletter archives.
watch_out: Free allowance is capped at 100 active subscribers; paid features such as analytics, segmentation, automations, RSS-to-email, paid subscriptions and team access require monthly add-ons. Commercial-use terms need confirmation.
